summary: The page is mostly clean and aligned, but contains a visual collision between the error callout and action button in the preview window.

issues.title: Error callout overlaps button
issues.description: The failure notification card is positioned directly over the primary payment button, causing text overlap and readability issues.
issues.evidence: The 'Payment failed' tooltip sits directly on top of the black 'Pay $148.00' button with overlapping text.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the annotation callout above or beside the target button to avoid visual collision.
